ideas.pitch: An AI-powered offline-first landslide and soil erosion prediction platform utilizing satellite imagery and local sensor inputs for mountain regions.
ideas.problem_statement: Developing practical and technology-driven solutions to real-world problems in regional infrastructure and safety.
ideas.title: HimalayanGeoAI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses regional geographic vulnerabilities specific to Dehradun and the Himalayas, matching the judges' priority for local impact.

ideas.pitch: A localized multi-lingual crop disease detection and yield optimization platform for small-scale farmers featuring offline edge inference.
ideas.title: AgriSarthi
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven pattern of localized healthcare/triage apps like mediscan-ai by tailoring computer vision specifically for regional agriculture.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage app combining rPPG heart rate monitoring with local language speech-to-text to assist remote health camps.
ideas.title: MediTriage-Hills
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the architecture of the winning mediscan-ai project with a working live demo of camera-based heart rate estimation.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered milestone tracker and automated pitching deck generator for early-stage startup incubation applicants.
ideas.title: SkillBridge-Incubator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the event's startup incubation support prize track by solving the administrative friction of vetting founders.

ideas.pitch: A real-time campus and municipal energy consumption monitoring dashboard with anomaly detection for local sustainability audits.
ideas.title: EcoGrid-Dehradun
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages time-series forecasting principles proven in the Apart Research AI Forecasting hackathon winner.
